Marina: Hey team — Carmen (new hire) just uploaded her passport and the last name on the passport is missing an accent compared to the offer letter (Ortega vs Ortégà). Day-1 is Monday (09:00). Need I-9 guidance + remote notary slot. Any objections to an exception affidavit + notary?
Oliver: No objections. This is a common issue. Do we have a signed document that ties the two spellings? If Carmen can bring the passport + an e-signed affidavit that the names are the same, that should work for I-9 intake.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: To book an I-9 mobile notary, use https://hr.redwood-infra/notary and complete the 'I-9 Remote Notary' form. Deadline: 24h before day 1.
Raj: Background check is currently 'in progress' because we couldn't verify SSN last night. Carmen, can you DM me a copy of your SSN card or provide the last 4 in the portal? Otherwise the background vendor will pause.
Marina: @Raj I just asked Carmen to upload the SSN via the secure portal; linking below. Also booking notary for 10:30am Monday tentatively.
Oliver: If vendor requires identity link, here's the fallback: passport + US driver's license + affidavit. We'll document the exception in the hire file.
Marina: Quick checklist I'm planning to follow for Monday:
- Confirm notary appointment 10:30
- I-9 intake + scan into Workday
- Background vendor final verification
- Badge and laptop pickup schedule at 14:00
- Assign orientation buddy (Marissa)

Marina: Fenced steps for the notary booking (copy paste):
```
1) Go to https://hr.redwood-infra/notary
2) Select 'I-9 Mobile' -> 'New Hire'
3) Upload passport scan + affidavit (pdf)
4) Choose location: 'Remote - Video' or 'Front Desk' if physical
5) Confirm 10:30 slot and add 'Carmen Ortega' as contact
```
Alex: IT here — laptop shipping OK. We'll ship to the address on file; if Carmen needs to pick up at office, we can hold at front desk. Please confirm preferred delivery by EOD.
IT-Asset: Asset request submitted for macbook-pro, charger, and secure case. ETA ship date: Mon 07:00AM. Link: https://assets.redwood-infra/req/PR-8342
Marissa: Happy to be Carmen's orientation buddy — I'll take onboarding at 09:30 and do a quick team intro + runbook walkthrough. Please add me to Carmen's calendar.
Marina: Thanks team — @Marissa I'll add you and drop the orientation agenda. Raj, please confirm when you have the final background status so we can clear day-1 access.
Raj: Will update by 15:00 today. If the SSN is uploaded today we should be green.
Marina: Great. I'll follow up with Carmen on the affidavit template and ping here when the notary is confirmed. :thumbsup:
